settings.text: 5% off every order, free shipping over $30, and 15% off each item once you have three.

settings.label: Can I change what is in my shipment?
settings.text: Yes. Add, remove or swap items from your account before the next ship date.

settings.label: How do I cancel?
settings.text: Open your subscription and choose cancel. There is no fee and no call to make.

settings.label: Can I skip a shipment?
settings.text: Yes, skip the next one and the schedule resumes after it.

settings.label: When am I billed?
settings.text: On the ship date, a few days after the reminder email.

settings.label: Can I change how often it ships?
settings.text: Yes, choose a new cadence at any time from the same screen.
